text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl has suffered an<n>injury, so I've
brought her to the<n>infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! This is nothing to cause<n>a fuss over.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just take a look! See?! Hup! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm as nimble as always,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So many possibilities are still waiting<n>to be explored,
so let's get back to<n>training!
choice_data_list: You should take a break to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sigh... All right. So that's your finaldecision...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Fine. That dance just now was the<n>best I could
muster. If it wasn't<n>enough to convince you...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then I guess I have no choice but to<n>take it easy
until I'm fully recovered.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you won't regret this! Let's go<n>and explore
my possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It seems I pushed my limits too far<n>and danced a
little too hard...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl's injury appears to<n>have taken a
heavy toll on her,<n>forcing her to take a break and
focus<n>on recovering.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wheeew! That was no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! As long as you don't lose<n>heart, nothing
in the world is<n>impossible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl demonstrates her<n>possibilities
magnificently by quickly<n>making a smooth
comeback.
